bio_draft: Su Real (Suhrid Manchanda) is a producer and DJ based in New Delhi, who moved there from New York in 2008. He became a resident DJ at Delhi club Livingroom and, with Nucleya, was among the first to bring tropical bass, moombahton and trap to India. His debut album Trapistan came out in 2014, and his recent releases are desi club edits such as the Panjabi Party Poppers series.
notes: Real name Suhrid Manchanda (Norient, Rolling Stone India): do not show as an alias. Norient says he moved from New York to New Delhi in 2008; a CKUT (Montreal campus radio) oral history page also names him as a former funding coordinator, so from_city is unclear and left null. Second album Twerkistan is confirmed by Krunk and Wild City but no release year was confirmed (Krunk page date 2024-04-30 looks like a site migration date, so press date left null). Homegrown page shows 2021-06-08, likely a republish date, left null. Bandcamp also has many remix singles (Brown Rang, Tun Tunak, Humma, Boom Boom etc.) without visible years; not added. Mixcloud has 34 shows; only the first 10 were visible. Spotify not checked.
